name: Diamond Lattice Cell (DCL) Tetrahedra
definition: An alternative cube slicing method where cubical cells are meshed into 5 tetrahedra using a (diamond cubic) lattice as a basis.
summary: Diamond Lattice Cell Tetrahedra partition cubic voxels into five tetrahedra using a diamond cubic lattice to ensure consistent diagonal interpolation and eliminate artifacts found in standard Marching Tetrahedra.
